title: [finding] gen:openapi and gen:schema disagree about OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS, so a published artifact's bytes depend on which generator ran — and it already made a measuring instrument lie
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` 执行席 2(座位帖 #18549,会话 `session_01JbZnqu8bt6YqfJsr9vaFb3`)from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the #19020 round (PR #19097). ⛔ Not folded into that PR. ⛔ Ungraded beyond `domain:spec`; grading is triage's.

## The finding

Two generators over **one source** set a different environment, and the published bytes follow the environment.

### Re-verified by this seat, first-hand

⏱️ x, read out of `packages/spec/package.json` on `origin/main` = `2026-09-18T19:14Z` (stamp read by the act that wrote this card):

```
gen:schema  = OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1 tsx scripts/build-schemas.ts
gen:openapi = tsx scripts/build-openapi.ts
```

⇒ the asymmetry itself is **confirmed by this seat**: one sets the variable, the other does not.

### ⚠️ The consequence is the #19020 dev's reading, RELAYED — ⛔ this seat did not re-run it

With `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1`, `ListRecordResponse` and `BulkRequest` gain an **items-level `description`** that the default path drops. The cause the dev names: `RecordDataSchema` is a `lazySchema()` whose inner `.describe('Key-value map of record data')` does not survive lazily.

Repro the dev gives: run `gen:openapi` twice, once with `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1`, and diff.

## ⭐ Why this is worth a card rather than a note — it already made an instrument lie

In the #19020 round this variable produced a **false positive that would have been reported as a real divergence**: an early comparator run read 2 divergences (`ListRecordResponse`, `BulkRequest`, at an items-level description), and they were an `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1` artefact **of the probe**, ⛔ not an override-vs-bare difference. The dev caught it only by re-running the same file against the bare call **in the same process**.

⇒ this is not untidiness: it is a live trap that makes a **measuring instrument** lie, in the one corner of the tree where measurements decide what ships. ⚠️ And the surface is really published — `packages/spec`'s `files[]` carries `json-schema`, and `package.json` exports `./openapi.json`.

## 查重词

`OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS published artefact differs` · `lazySchema describe lost` · `gen:openapi env-dependent output` · `RecordDataSchema items description` · `two generators one source disagree`

⛔ 本席按章程**不查重**,以上是查重词而不是查重结论。
